rationale: The assistant prioritised clearing airflow, then correctly identified the heater circuit (cut-out or element) as the likely fault and honestly said the two cannot be told apart without a continuity test. It refused to name a part from 'DV7110' alone, and since the customer has no meter and cannot reach the rear label, it escalated to an engineer, as expected. Minor weaknesses: it did not ask about a resettable cut-out, and the first reply had a slightly muddled instruction about setting checks and a mild repeat of the airflow advice. Even so, the advice was safe and calibrated.
